blocks.label: relationships
blocks.extractionHint: What has actually happened between each character and the player: which line or which moment changed the distance between them, and what they said or kept to themselves. Affection is tracked in the affinity panel, and stage, trust and pressure in the Heart Routes dimension; write only the details worth remembering here, never the numbers.

blocks.label: campus_schedule
blocks.extractionHint: The current location and weather, the next bell or plan for closing time, which characters could naturally turn up, and where anyone has arranged to go. The world-time plugin owns the current date and time of day; do not keep a second clock in memory.
